problem.observed: Formal refresh at fixed 037a88e passed the durable lease wait and official ingestion but failed actual_readback: controller deployment identity missing.
problem.cause: The bounded one-shot controller was started with -e SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH=/data/source-ingest/bounded-refresh/controller_state.json (and a second ALIVE path), while SourceRuntime authoritative readback reads /data/source-ingest/controller_state.json from docker-compose.yml. Writer id/sequence/runtime-instance therefore differed from the state the API read back, although both persisted deployments had identity_complete=true and the same GIT_SHA/image digest.

change: Removed only the bounded compose run -e SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH override so the one-shot controller writes the compose-declared state that SourceRuntime reads back. The bounded -e SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_ALIVE_PATH=/data/source-ingest/bounded-refresh/controller_alive override is preserved (per-process liveness separation); steady controller stays stopped/fenced for the window.
unchanged: max_ticks=1, no-build/no-pull, egress allowlist, real reader validation, native steady lease wait and 10s one-shot interval, exact source image/env restore, expected controller id/sequence/deployment identity, CAS/tenant, calendar/freshness and gates. No freshness grace, provider, retry, adapter, wrapper, lock or service added.
test_changes: Replaced the env-only test with a regression through the real config_from_env, ControllerStateStore and SourceIngestionRuntime readback: the authoritative state holds a steady identity/sequence (steady-old/41) with retained recent_operations; the bounded writer loads its configured path, advances to bounded-fresh/42 and saves. With the original separate STATE_PATH override the API readback stays steady-old/41 (mismatch reproduced); with the shipped args the readback is bounded-fresh/42 with history retained. Also asserts the bounded ALIVE_PATH stays separate.
